Formerly Nora Tansky.  She is married to [[User:Bob LeChevalier|Bob LeChevalier]], and doesn't participate directly (except as relayed through Bob) in the Internet manifestations of Lojban, so her important role often goes unrecognized:

# writing the Diagrammed Grammar Summary

# author of [[Logflash]] (although the algorithm was designed by [[jbocre: James Cooke Brown|James Cooke Brown]])

# writing the index to the [[jbocre: refgramm|refgramm]].

# reviewing almost everything LLG has ever published

#doing substantial review of Nicholas' lujvo list

Lojban is perhaps the only [[jbocre: constructed language|constructed language]] built by a married couple.
